4. Place a yellow #FFFF99 circle with a dark #000000 outline in the top-right corner containing the slide number '16' in black.
5. Draw a pale-yellow #FFFFCC rectangle at upper-left (~5-40% width, ~18-30% height); inside it place 'Model' in red italic bold, then 'I/P: ( x1  x2  x3  .....  xn )' with red #FF0000 parentheses, then 'O/P: ( y )' in black.

9. Draw a pale-yellow #FFFFCC rectangle at middle-left (~5-38% width, ~58-78% height); inside it place 'y =' followed by the row vector '(w1  w2  ...  wn)' in blue parentheses multiplied by the column vector '[x1; x2; ...; xn]' in red parentheses, then '+ b' with b in blue.

11. Draw a pale-green #CCFFCC rectangle at middle-center (~42-72% width, ~58-82% height); inside it place 'y =' followed by the row vector '(b  w1  w2  ...  wd)' in blue parentheses multiplied by the augmented column vector '[1; x1; x2; ...; xd]' in red parentheses, with the leading '1' in red.
12. Draw a second light-pink #FFCCCC outlined right-pointing arrow in the gap at ~72-75% width and ~65-70% height, pointing from the step-11 box to the step-13 box.
13. Draw a white #FFFFFF rectangle with a dark border at middle-right (~75-92% width, ~62-72% height); inside it place bold 'y = W^T X' with 'W^T' underlined in red.
14. Draw a peach #FFE0CC rectangle at bottom-left (~5-42% width, ~80-97% height); inside it place 'Note:' in red underlined, the line '"b" may be added at begin of the vector or at end of the vector' with 'begin' and 'end' underlined, and the line 'Same for "1" added to input vector'.
15. Draw a pale-green #CCFFCC rectangle at bottom-center (~42-68% width, ~84-97% height); inside it place three lines: 'y = W^T X' with 'W^T' underlined in red; 'Where X is Augmented vector' with 'X' in red; 'W is  d+1 dimension' with 'W' in red and 'd+1' in blue.
